scope: Fixed 20-core platypus regional masks and the identical Tiberius softmask receiver

source.sequence_contract: The frozen prepared c00-c19 sequence.txt files; 5,200,000 bases per core after stripping the terminal newline
source.pooled_discovery_input: One FASTA with the twenty fixed core+halo sequences as independent contigs; 104,000,000 bp total. Contigs are not concatenated and retain their fixed record IDs.
source.halo_overlap: No overlap among the twenty fixed halo intervals was observed; contig boundaries are still retained explicitly.
source.truth_contract: Reference-relative CDS-chain/locus endpoint from reference.json; annotations are comparators, not independent biological truth

RM2.name: RepeatModeler2 followed by RepeatMasker
RM2.discovery: One pooled FASTA of the twenty fixed 5.2 Mb halo contigs; this 104 Mb regional-panel discovery cost is not a whole-genome runtime claim
RM2.library_policy: Use the complete discovered classified library, including Unknown entries; do not filter by downstream outcome. Report classified and Unknown rows separately.

RED.name: Red 2.0 ab initio repeat mask
parameters: Red -gnm genome -msk masked -rpt repeats -cor 4 -frm 2 on the pooled panel
RED.semantic_scope: All detected repeats; Red does not provide RepeatMasker family classification, so its output is reported as an all-repeat mask rather than a TE-family map

receiver.checkpoint: frozen existing Tiberius weights; no training, threshold, or calibration change

endpoint.primary: RM2 minus D and RM2 minus R_TE reference-relative locus F1, with Red reported in the same table
endpoint.bootstrap: 10,000 chromosome-cluster paired resamples, seed 42; spatial uncertainty, not training seeds
endpoint.controls: Reuse qualified D, U_soft, U_nosm, R_TE, R_all, and P3 results from D-TIBERIUS-PLATYPUS-20260917 on identical cores

resources.mask_cpu: Requested ceiling 16 CPUs/80 GB; actual Baobab account-compatible run uses 4 CPUs/64 GB, at most two pooled method jobs concurrently, at most 24 h
resources.tiberius_gpu: one RTX3090, 8 CPUs, 96 GB per cell, at most one new GPU cell concurrently
resources.scheduling: Execution-only concurrency or wall-limit changes are recorded after submission; scientific inputs, weights, thresholds, cores, and endpoints remain frozen
